chunks: From him, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a man who sees blood on his garment, then forgets to wash it until he performs salat (prayer). He said: He repeats his salat (prayer), so that he may be attentive regarding a thing when it is in his garment, as a punishment for his forgetting.
ai.seo_question: If someone sees blood on his garment, forgets to wash it, and then prays, must he repeat the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who knew of blood on his garment but forgot to wash it before performing salat (prayer). Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that he must repeat the prayer, and describes this as a consequence for his negligence and forgetfulness.
